human_rubric.citation_support: Check every important claim against the retained passage and original URL.
human_rubric.coverage: Count required question facets answered; an unanswered question cannot pass solely because its citations match.
human_rubric.freshness: Verify publication dates and current applicability independently.
human_rubric.contradiction: Check recall on known conflicts; a missing conflict is not agreement.
human_rubric.utility: Founder completes question-to-verification task on an iPhone without guidance.
